name: Custom Shape 3D Wooden Fridge Magnet
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood material for durability and a premium finish.
    - Product includes 2 main parts: base layer and insert piece with a wooden 5mm thickness.
    - Equipped with a magnetic sheet backing for secure attachment to refrigerators or metal surfaces.
    - Precision laser-cut edges for smooth and clean contours.
    - Layered construction creates a raised 3D visual effect.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Base size: 3 x 3 inches ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm.
    - Insert piece maximum size : 3 inches ~ 7.62 cm.
    - Insert piece minimum size: 0.78 inches ~ 2 cm.
    - Insert thickness: 0.19 in ~ 0.5 cm connection slot area.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details and long-lasting color.
    - Base Layer: 1-sided printing.
    - Insert Piece: 2-sided printing.
    - High-definition printing enhances depth and layered appearance.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative 3D layered fridge magnet.
    - Easily attaches to refrigerators, lockers, whiteboards, and other metal surfaces.
    - The insert piece fits securely into the base slot.
    - Lightweight yet durable for everyday use.
    - Adds a personalized and artistic touch to your kitchen or workspace.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A creative and eye-catching personalized gift.
    - Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, and holidays.
    - Perfect for couples, family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - A unique keepsake that combines functionality with decorative charm.
    - Great for celebrating meaningful moments in a small yet memorable way 🎁.

    SPECIFICATION
  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 3D Wooden Fridge Magnet

 

PRODUCTION

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
